package postgres

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// SectionI18nRepoPG implements SectionI18nRepository.
type SectionI18nRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

func (r SectionI18nRepoPG) Upsert(ctx context.Context, entry domain.SectionI18n) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO section_i18n (section_id, i18n_id, title, description)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4)
ON CONFLICT (section_id, i18n_id) DO UPDATE SET title=EXCLUDED.title, description=EXCLUDED.description`,
		entry.SectionID, entry.I18nID, entry.Title, entry.Description)
	return err
}

func (r SectionI18nRepoPG) ListBySection(ctx context.Context, sectionID string) ([]domain.SectionI18n, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, `
SELECT si.section_id, si.i18n_id, i.language, si.title, si.description
FROM section_i18n si
JOIN i18n i ON i.id = si.i18n_id
WHERE si.section_id=$1
ORDER BY i.language`, sectionID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	result := []domain.SectionI18n{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var entry domain.SectionI18n
		if err := rows.Scan(&entry.SectionID, &entry.I18nID, &entry.Language, &entry.Title, &entry.Description); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, entry)
	}
	return result, rows.Err()
}

func (r SectionI18nRepoPG) Delete(ctx context.Context, sectionID string, i18nID int) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	cmd, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM section_i18n WHERE section_id=$1 AND i18n_id=$2`, sectionID, i18nID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if cmd.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return nil
}

var _ repository.SectionI18nRepository = (*SectionI18nRepoPG)(nil)
